'''Iothene Jacontro''' was a [[Kerestian]] [[Gender|male]] who worked as a [[big game hunter]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
Jacontro visited [[Vandor]] yearly, usually to hunt for animals or treasure. Initially, he was searching for the [[Corubalni Hoard]]. While doing this, he released a group of [[Wampa]]s on the planet and let people hunt them down as trophies. However, before the hunt began, his crew got into a brawl with a group of [[Selkath]] [[pirate]]s known as the [[Valarine School]]. When Jacontro came down the next morning to start the hunt, he found most of his group dead or locked in [[Prison|jail]]. He was forced to hire most of the undependable regulars of [[The Lodge]] to fill out the party. He and his group left to search for the treasure. While they were gone, the wampas he had released made their way to [[Fort Ypso]] and started to attack the [[Kod'yok]] herds. The owner of The Lodge, [[Tibbs Ospe]], was forced to put together a hunting party to kill them before they destroyed the settlement. Jacontro returned alone after losing his whole crew and with a severely frostbitten [[Limb|arm]]. As he was settling his debts, a bull wampa burst into The Lodge and began attacking everyone present. Opse returned in time to kill the beast. The arms were stuffed and mounted in a back room that was named Iothene's Den after the hunter who was responsible for the attack.<ref name="Tales" />
He later was part of a crew who were convinced that a [[vastadon]] lived in the [[mountain]]s of the [[planet]] [[Vandor]], and returned to the world each [[Standard year|year]] to brave the wilderness and search for the beast, even after he lost his right [[Limb|arm]] to [[gangrene]] caused by exposure to the elements.<ref name="SoloOG" /> In [[10 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' dates the portion of ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' set on [[Vandor]] to nine [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|founding]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the founding of the Empire to [[19 BBY]] and so the events on Vandor must occur in [[10 BBY]].</ref> Jacontro spent time in [[the Lodge]] on Vandor,<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> where many thought his quest for the vastadon was foolish.<ref name="SoloOG" /> While at the Lodge, Jacontro watched a game of [[sabacc]] being played in the back room<ref name="Solo" />

==Equipment==
He wore a [[Color|black]] climber's mask with [[oxygen]] concentrators, a brown [[Cape|cloak]] and a black [[Clothing|tunic]].<ref name="SoloOG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Iothene Jacontro first appeared in the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''<ref name="Solo" /> and was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="SoloOG" />
